dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: What do you think about bảo mật relationships? I have a friend who's dating a married man. She says their love needs to be bảo mật because of social circumstances.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Really? I don't think any bảo mật relationship is good. If you have to hide your feelings, then perhaps it's not true tình yêu. Tình yêu should be open and proud.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: You make it sound so easy. But sometimes, feelings aren't that simple. There are relationships that need to be bảo mật for many reasons... Like... my cảm xúc right now.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Your cảm xúc? Mira, what are you implying? If you have something to say, I'm always ready to listen. I think the truth is always better than keeping everything in the dark.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: It's nothing! I'm just talking about feelings in general! Don't think too much. But... if I really did have something to tell you, how would you react?
